item.text: {"action":"experiment","hypothesis":"A05 remains the best guard-eligible configuration. L007 showed that hist_gradient_boosting/raw on the large other route trades better positive-Tc MAE for worse reported-zero MAE and slightly worse pooled MAE. The complementary focused test is to use hist_gradient_boosting/raw only for cu_o while preserving A05's extra_trees/raw other expert and broad extra_trees/raw fallback for fe_anion. A04 suggests this cu_o estimator can improve positive- and high-Tc errors, but A04 confounded it with a separate fe_anion expert; omitting that expert isolates the cu_o change.","falsification":"The hypothesis is falsified as an eligible improvement if pooled weighted OOF MAE is not below 7.742598770753422 K, representing the required 0.01 K gain over A05, or if positive-Tc MAE exceeds the fixed G01 guard of 8.832165507919859 K. Improvements confined to positive- or high-Tc subgroups would remain tradeoffs rather than an eligible win.","reason":"The continuation minimum is pending, and this is an untried, controlled model-only perturbation of A05.
